versions.rationale: One patch for focused documentation corrections; description, dependencies, role and technology baseline unchanged.

baseline.applicableInstructions: AGENTS.md, complete docs/skill-review-prompt.md, docs/parallel-skill-reviews.md, wave3 review brief, skill-engineering and all four evidence/evaluation/resource-design/anti-pattern references.
baseline.comparativeEvidence: Wave-two original and revised skills both satisfied 6/6 development cases; no incremental behavioral gain shown. This review does not claim otherwise.

findings.location: SKILL.md workflow step 3; references/diagnosing-elimination.md procedure step 2 and LogCompilation section
findings.observation: The previous procedure associated an elimination entry with an installed C2 nmethod using compile ID and method/BCI, but did not reject transformations from discarded attempts within the same task.
findings.evidence: OpenJDK jdk-25.0.3-ga C2Compiler::compile_method retries Compile with the same ciEnv and task; Compile::record_failure logs the failure and discards its graph. Task completion and nmethod installation can succeed after an earlier transformation was abandoned.
findings.consequence: An agent could conclude that the installed code eliminated an allocation even when only a failed attempt contains that event.
findings.fix: Read failure/reparse order and task outcome; require attribution to the successful attempt, preserve unresolved final allocation behavior when the evidence does not show it.

findings.location: SKILL.md workflow step 3; references/diagnosing-elimination.md LogCompilation section
findings.observation: Global flags are insufficient to establish the options of a retried Compile.
findings.evidence: C2Compiler::compile_method initializes local booleans from globals and changes different booleans for no-EA, no-iterative-EA, no-allocation-merge and no-subsuming-load retries.
findings.consequence: A positive PrintFlagsFinal value could be mistaken for proof that the corresponding optimization ran in the successful attempt; unrelated retry reasons could also be overgeneralized.
findings.fix: Interpret the actual version-matched failure reason, separate local options from global configuration, and distinguish compilation retry from runtime deoptimization.

changes.detail: Adds a short failure/retry guard at the compiler-evidence decision point.

Corrects the positive-elimination branch, explains same-task retries and per-attempt options, directs correction of affected conclusions while preserving valid measurements, and adds three version-pinned primary source links.

preserved: Diagnostic role and HotSpot C2/JDK 25 emphasis, with actual target-build inspection and Graal handoff.
Connection graph, fixed-point propagation, flow insensitivity, NoEscape/ArgEscape/GlobalEscape distinctions and BCEA bytecode-limit reasoning.
Allocation merges, scalar-replacement eligibility, boxing, string-concatenation lowering and unused-allocation removal.
Balanced lock eligibility, identity/semantic constraints, deoptimization rematerialization and valid alternatives including no change.
EA-disabled controls, allocation-counter support/thread scope, partial-average cautions, JFR sampling/enablement limits and compile-ID/method/BCI/inline attribution.
Historical measurements remain explicitly labeled as historical and not independently reproducible from the shipped package.
All of references/connection-graph.md unchanged; manifest description, dependencies, capability metadata and both resource routes unchanged.
